summary: Board redraw keeps a clan plaque whose displayed facts are unchanged instead of rebuilding both after every command (about 4 ms of a 33 ms RenderBoard; 33.5 to 28.5 ms measured in a bot-played game). Retained card tiles were also tried (93% reuse) and gave no measurable gain, so they were dropped.
validation: perf harness before/after; native checks check-clan-placard, check-player-clarity, check-fallen, check-interactions, check-tutorial pass; 8 board captures render without errors
remaining: None for this change. Remaining redraw cost is spread over text-heavy HUD widgets and tree churn; see PR.
